messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to start canary for model-v7 this week. Goal: validate latency/cost regressions and safety signals before full rollout. thinking small regional ramp first (eu -> na) and strict percent steps.

maria: thanks. do we have the exact percent schedule? curious about min-viable exposure for evals.

alex: proposed: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. hold at each step for 2h+ and check metrics dashboard + safety evals. keep eu only for first 24h.

jamal: nit: 0.5% might be hard to slice reliably, ops infra supports 1% slices natively. i'd prefer 1% start.

alex: ok swapping to 1% start. update below.

lia: can we gate on both error-rate and median p95 latency? suggest abort if p95 > 1.5x baseline or error-rate > 0.5%. also add quality regressions from eval set (prompt-regression-job).

maria: +1 on thresholds. also add token-cost delta alert (>10% increase) so finance doesn't get surprised.

ops-bot: @alex scheduled canary window: 2026-03-20 09:00-17:00 UTC. Reservation ID: res-34fa.

alex: perfect. ops, can you reserve extra capacity for bursting so we don't hit tail latency from autoscale?

ops-bot: capacity bump queued. will provision +20% GPUs in eu region for the window.

jamal: what's the plan for rollbacks? auto-fallback to v6 or manual?

alex: prefer auto-fallback to v6 on guard triggers. rollout config will look like:

```json
{"model":"model-v7","fallback":"model-v6","guards":[{"metric":"p95_latency","threshold":1.5},{"metric":"error_rate","threshold":0.005}],"steps":[{"percent":1,"region":"eu"},{"percent":5,"region":"eu"},{"percent":10,"region":"eu"},{"percent":50,"region":"global"},{"percent":100,"region":"global"}]}
```

lia: pls also add a canary test out that hits the most common prompt templates and smoke-checks semantic parity (auto-eval job id will be created).

maria: who will own the monitoring during the window? @sre-oncall or product?

sre-oncall: i'll own the first block (09:00-13:00 UTC). @maria can you pair for the 13:00-17:00 handoff?

maria: yes i can. i'll be on standby with the eval harness and watch the regression alerts.

deploy-bot: canary config uploaded to releases/canaries/model-v7/2124688888.json by alex. CI check passed.

alex: thanks. final checklist for tomorrow: 1) ops capacity bump confirmed, 2) canary config in repo, 3) auto-fallback enabled, 4) dashboards + alerts live, 5) smoke eval job queued. comment here if anything missing.

jamal: code review pinged for the toggle flag change (PR #4827). please review before 08:30 UTC.

lia: adding the eval job now and will post job id when ready.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled 30m before window.

alex: excellent. if nothing else i'll flip the first 1% at 09:05 UTC and post status updates here. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria: see you then.
